answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one garden plot, naming five neighbors to endorse it by key in the tide. Auditors replay the garden ledger per tide; endorsements below the ledge fail; one key signing twice burns both. First endorsement costs 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented endorsements carry their owner's key; reuse burns both. Honest agents pay 38 once, keep their bond.
